_note: Active abilities. cost is essence; reflux_per_cost is how much reflux each essence point leaves behind, on that ability's affinity. Progress (0-100 per stage) advances by essence spent through the ability times a use multiplier (balance.abilities); a full stage waits for a bound construct of the matching tier (design/01 LAW 4). Which abilities a character starts with comes from the kits in affinities.json. kinds: projectile | melee_burst | dash | beam | targeted_strike | blink (design/05 Appendix A). A skill touches an enemy through a hit payload - on_hit / on_pass / on_arrive - with any of: damage or damage_mult (taken from the skill when absent), status, shove (metres), marks (Live), interrupts. 'summary' is the one-line rule shown to the player. Water and lightning are built to design/05 step 1 and fire to step 3 (a dash may carry 'trail', a strip of ground that applies a payload every tick_s, and 'stops_at_bodies'; a targeted_strike may 'consume_status' for per_stack_damage and a 'burst'); wind to step 3 too (a projectile may 'pierce' and 'spend_pips' for 'pip_damage' each; a dash may 'gain_pips' and have 'no_recovery'; a targeted_strike may have its own 'range', go 'through' to 'through_dist' behind the target, 'force_rear', and take 'pip_mult' per pip with 'spend_all_pips'); earth to step 3 too: any skill may have a 'windup' (it is paid for at once and goes off that many seconds later; you are rooted and aimed until then) and be 'braced' through it (balance.braced); 'shatters_stone' breaks the caster's own stone (balance.stone); kind 'prop' raises a slab 'width' x 'thickness' x 'height' across your aim at the cursor, between 'min_range' and 'range' away, up in 'rise_time', standing 'life' seconds, and applies 'on_rise' to whoever is standing there. Abilities do NOT hurt their caster (Brent 2026-10-11). Every name and verse is original to this project - the two water skills that carried the books' own names were renamed on 2026-10-12 (ids kept for saves). Numbers are first guesses [MODEL]. STEP 5a: skills outside the starter kits are learned from scroll items (items.json kind 'scroll'). New kinds - displace (mode pull_area: enemies within 'radius' of the aimed point are dragged 'pull' metres toward it; pull_target: one enemy is hauled to 'keep' metres in front of you and turned away for 'turn_s'; aloft_area: on_hit to everyone in 'radius', +'pip_seconds' of it per pip spent); delayed_blast (a marked circle of 'radius' at the aimed point goes off after 'delay': on_hit to everyone in it, 'bonus_damage' to those with 'bonus_vs_status', may 'kill_projectiles', shatter stone, and 'leave_prop'); detonate (every enemy within 'range' carrying 'consume_status' loses it: 'per_stack_burst' damage per stack in 'burst_radius', or an Overload scaled by 'overload_fracs'); chain (on_hit to a target and up to 'jumps' more, each within 'jump_radius' of the last). A melee_burst may take its damage from heat ('damage_from_heat' per point above 'heat_floor', and the reflux drops to the floor) and may 'shatters_all_stone'.

water_bolt.name: Water Bolt
water_bolt.summary: First enemy hit is Soaked and knocked back a step.

tsunami_strike.name: Breaker
tsunami_strike.summary: A wide blow that throws everyone it hits 4 m away from you. Stand so the wall is behind them.

hydraulic_flex.name: Sluice Step
hydraulic_flex.summary: A short dash straight through enemies, Soaking each one you pass.

cinder_spit.name: Cinder Spit
cinder_spit.verse: A coal from the mouth. It was never going to stay in.
cinder_spit.summary: A quick, cheap bolt that sets its target Alight. Weak cold; it is how you get hot.

kiln_fist.name: Kiln Fist
kiln_fist.verse: Fire the hand like clay. Then find out what it breaks.
kiln_fist.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Alight, interrupts. If it was already burning, every stack is spent for +40 and the blow bursts, lighting those beside it.

flashover.name: Flashover
flashover.verse: The room does not burn slowly. Neither do you.
flashover.summary: A short dash that leaves a line of flame for 3 s: anything standing in it catches. It does not carry you through enemies.

slingstone.name: Slingstone
slingstone.verse: A stone has all the time there is. Lend it yours.
slingstone.summary: The slowest bolt and the heaviest. It stops what it hits mid-swing and all but staggers it. Thrown into your own stone, it shatters it.

landslide_blow.name: Landslide Blow
landslide_blow.verse: The hill does not swing. It simply stops holding on.
landslide_blow.summary: A narrow, slow, crushing blow: it staggers anything short of an elite, moves nobody, and shatters every stone of yours in its arc.

bedrock_shove.name: Bedrock Shove
bedrock_shove.verse: Put your shoulder where the mountain keeps its own.
bedrock_shove.summary: Not in the starter kit: earth starts with no movement skill. It returns as a scroll with the later skills.

cutting_gust.name: Cutting Gust
cutting_gust.verse: Air has an edge. Most people never find it.
cutting_gust.summary: A short gust that passes through everything in its line. Spends up to 3 pips for +15 each - weak from a standstill.

downdraft.name: Downdraft
downdraft.summary: Point, 8 m, 4 m wide: 50, interrupts, pins enemies for 2 s, knocks their shots out of the air, and does +100 to anything Aloft.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.verse: Something behind you agrees you should leave.
tailwind.summary: The longest dash, +3 pips, and the only one with no recovery: you can strike or cast the instant it ends.

arc_lash.name: Arc Lash
arc_lash.verse: It was there and now it is here.
arc_lash.summary: Instant, short, cannot miss what it points at. Leaves 1 Live mark. Walls stop it.

thunderclap_palm.name: Thunderclap Palm
thunderclap_palm.verse: The sound arrives after the damage, to apologise.
thunderclap_palm.summary: One enemy, in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Live marks, and it stops whatever they were doing.

stepped_leader.name: Stepped Leader
stepped_leader.verse: Find the path first. Then take all of it at once.
stepped_leader.summary: You are simply there, up to 6 m away. 1 Live mark on everything beside where you land.

crosscut.name: Crosscut
crosscut.verse: Do not meet them. Pass through where they were looking.
crosscut.summary: One enemy within 7 m: you cut through and stop behind it. Always a hit from behind. Spends every pip for +10% each.

raise_slab.name: Raise Slab
raise_slab.verse: Ask the floor to stand up. It remembers how.
raise_slab.summary: A wall of stone across your aim, up to 8 m away. It blocks movement and shots - theirs and yours - for 12 s. Three at a time.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.verse: The floor of the room leans.
undertow.summary: Point, 9 m: every enemy within 4 m of the spot is dragged up to 4 m toward it and Soaked. No damage of its own - but bodies that collide Crush each other.

riptide_lash.name: Riptide Lash
riptide_lash.verse: A rope of water for one throat.
riptide_lash.summary: One enemy within 10 m is hauled to arm's length, takes 60, is Soaked and interrupted - and arrives with its back to you for a second.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.summary: Everything within 5 m takes 4 x the heat you carry above 20 - and your fire reflux drops to 20. 320 at full heat; nothing when cold.

pyre_call.name: Pyre Call
pyre_call.summary: Every Alight enemy within 10 m loses its stacks, and each stack bursts for 35 in 2 m. Spread the burns first; call them once.

pillar.name: Pillar
pillar.verse: The ground has an opinion about where they are standing.
pillar.summary: Point, 9 m: a circle is marked for half a second, then a column punches up - 120, 60 poise, interrupts - and stays as stone.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.verse: Everything standing is standing on your say-so.
tremor.summary: Everything within 5 m takes 60, is interrupted and slowed for 3 s - and every stone you have standing shatters outward at once.

updraft.name: Updraft
updraft.verse: What goes up is yours until it comes down.
updraft.summary: Point, 8 m: enemies within 2.5 m are thrown Aloft for 1.2 s (+0.2 s a pip, up to 4) - helpless, and taking 25% more. Heavy ones lose poise instead.

forked_path.name: Forked Path
forked_path.verse: It does not choose. It takes every road.
forked_path.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then up to three more within 5 m of each other: 50 and 1 Live mark each. Never the same body twice.

dead_short.name: Dead Short
dead_short.verse: Everything you have marked, all at once, for less.
dead_short.summary: Every marked enemy within 12 m Overloads now: 40% of the full blow and stun at 1 mark, 70% at 2, all of it at 3. It grounds no reflux.
